categories.main_business_segments: Beijing New Building Materials Public Limited Company (BNBM) operates primarily in three segments: lightweight building materials (mainly gypsum boards and steel studs), waterproof building materials, and coatings. The company produces and sells gypsum boards, steel studs, waterproof membranes, waterproof coatings, and architectural and industrial coatings. It also engages in related product manufacturing and sales, including mineral wool, decorative panels, and construction materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: BNBM utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including high-speed intelligent gypsum board production lines with speeds up to 160m/min, low-carbon and energy-efficient production processes, and innovative material formulations such as aerogel-based insulating gypsum boards and antibacterial gypsum composites. The company emphasizes green manufacturing, digital transformation, and R&D platforms including national enterprise technology centers and postdoctoral research stations to drive product innovation and process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad customer base including real estate developers, public and commercial building contractors, home decoration companies, and retail consumers. Its gypsum boards are widely used in commercial buildings, public facilities, and residential construction, with growing penetration in residential wall applications. Waterproof and coating products target infrastructure, transportation, industrial, and residential sectors. The company also focuses on expanding into emerging international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: BNBM operates extensively across China with production bases and sales networks covering northern, southern, and western regions. It has established overseas subsidiaries and production facilities in Tanzania, Uzbekistan, Thailand, and Bosnia and Herzegovina, targeting emerging markets in Africa, Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and Eastern Europe. The company pursues a global layout strategy focusing on these key international regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: BNBM operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the building materials supply chain. It manufactures core building materials such as gypsum boards, steel studs, waterproof membranes, and coatings, and sells these products directly to construction companies, developers, and distributors. The company also integrates upstream raw material sourcing, including industrial by-product gypsum, to ensure supply stability and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include strengthening its core gypsum board business ('one body'), expanding waterproof and coating businesses ('two wings'), and accelerating global market expansion. R&D focuses on green, low-carbon technologies, intelligent manufacturing, functional and high-performance materials, and digital transformation. Key projects include aerogel gypsum boards, high-durability waterproof membranes, multifunctional coatings, and smart factory construction. The company also emphasizes innovation in business models and service offerings.
categories.revenue_model: BNBM generates revenue primarily through product sales of gypsum boards, steel studs, waterproof materials, and coatings. Sales are conducted via a combination of direct sales and a dense dealer network covering urban and rural markets. The company also earns income from investment returns, government subsidies, and limited licensing or technology transfer activities. Revenue growth is driven by volume increases, product mix optimization, and geographic expansion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: BNBM is the leading gypsum board manufacturer in China, holding the largest market share domestically. It competes with international and domestic companies producing high-end, mid-range, and low-end gypsum products. The company’s competitive advantages include strong brand recognition (e.g., 'Longpai', 'Taishan'), extensive production capacity, advanced technology, and comprehensive product portfolios. It is recognized as a national champion and innovation leader in the building materials industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, BNBM reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 25.82 billion, a 15.14% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.65 billion, up 3.49%. The company maintains a strong cash flow position with operating cash flow exceeding RMB 5.13 billion. It has substantial fixed assets and ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology upgrades. The company’s growth is supported by both organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, such as the 78.34% acquisition of North New Jiabao Li Coatings.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: BNBM emphasizes green technology and quality living as its mission, offering environmentally friendly, energy-saving, and high-performance building materials. Its gypsum boards provide superior fire resistance, sound insulation, and lightweight properties. The company differentiates through integrated product solutions, extensive R&D capabilities, and a full lifecycle green building materials chain from raw materials to recycling. Its strong brand portfolio and comprehensive service system enhance customer loyalty and market coverage.
